rationale: Frozen answer 7.6% matches only the Jan-Sep 2018 PPF rate per e2 span s1. Both sources agree the current rate as of the audit date (2026-07-21) is 7.1%, unchanged since April 1, 2020 (e1 spans s1/s2; e2 span s2: 'April 2020 - September 2026 | 7.1%'). This makes 7.6% a superseded historical value, not the current rate. The e2 table delimits the 7.6% period as ending September 2018, so it stopped applying the following month; the exact subsequent rate(s) between Oct 2018 and Apr 2020 are not in evidence, so change_date reflects only when 7.6% ceased to be valid.
